fields.en: Giving is a Christian’s privilege, responsibility and a channel of blessing. God is pleased when believers give willingly. You can give in the following ways.
fields.hant: 奉獻是基督徒的權利ˎ義務和蒙福的管道, 信徒樂意的奉獻，必為神所悅納。大家可以透過以下的途徑進行奉獻:

fields.en: Give through the church’s PayPal donation page.
fields.hant: 透過教會的 PayPal 奉獻頁面進行奉獻。
